tossups.text: This condition requires complete markets and perfect information according to the Greenwald-Stiglitz theorem, which is a partial converse to the Arrow-Debreu theorem. This person's namesake number is low for tracers in PIV and equals the ratio between a particle's characteristic response time and an obstacle's response time. As all its subjects were male, it was followed by studies which found that females behaved the same, although more nervously, and several other variations including one using a telephone and one using a contact plate. As the only mortal member of her kind, her head was placed on Athena's shield, the aegis, after she was decapitated by the eventual founder of Mycenae, whereupon Chrysaor and Pegasus emerged from her neck.
